bullets: Led the SingleView v9-to-v12 upgrade across 14 countries covering millions of accounts, with an 8-person team per upgrade, delivered within a planned 6-hour downtime window.

Migrated ~400 enterprise customers and ~2,500 services, including balances, from manual to automated billing with no downtime.
Built the configuration-driven REST API framework that nearly all current and new REST APIs are built on, so new APIs are set up through configuration instead of new code.
